## Problem

What security or developer problem should AgentSec solve?

## Proposed capability

Describe the behavior you want.

## Security value

What risk, blind spot or workflow gap does this address?

## Evidence source

Would this feature rely on:

- [ ] source/configuration review
- [ ] architecture reasoning
- [ ] dependency metadata
- [ ] local host inspection
- [ ] remote authorized testing
- [ ] third-party scanner output
- [ ] cloud/provider configuration

## False-positive considerations

What conditions could make the recommendation incorrect or incomplete?

## Remediation / verification

How should AgentSec verify the finding and how should a fix be retested?

## Safety considerations

Explain any active-testing or high-impact behavior. AgentSec should remain defensive and non-destructive by default.
